wire.t: Chargers 23, Ravens 20 on Monday night, and it flipped a fantasy game. Omarion Hampton ran for 105 yards and a touchdown (19.0), Tre' Harris caught five for 86 (12.6) and Justice Hill added 7.8, so Asian Jim beat Kraft for Cash 123.46 to 99.20. Zay Flowers had 74 yards and 9.9.

Derrick Henry ran 10 times for 10 yards and scored twice in the loss, 16.5 for Hold My DK, which finished at 196.34. Jacoby Brissett threw for 340 yards with no touchdowns and an interception, 12.3 for Dude, Your Getting a Dell.

Drake Maye needs more tests on his ankle, and reports say the Patriots feared a fracture. New England is on bye in Week 11 and Mike Vrabel said he wouldn't imagine Maye being available coming out of it. Tommy DeVito replaced him in Munich.
Brock Bowers is day-to-day with the ankle he hurt against Seattle, and Ian Rapoport reported it isn't believed to be a major injury. He's listed Out on Sleeper. The Raiders play Denver next.

Kenneth Walker III (groin) is expected to play Sunday against Arizona, per Ian Rapoport, who called last week's absence precautionary. That's good news for Catfan94’s Farm Team and less good for Emmett Johnson's 34.6-point week on LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix.

Six teams are on bye in Week 11: Atlanta, Cleveland, Green Bay, the Rams, New England and Seattle. That takes out Michael Penix Jr. and Jordan Love for LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix, Deshaun Watson for Catfan94’s Farm Team and Jaxon Smith-Njigba for Asian Jim.
No transactions since Saturday, when jmello16 added Mack Hollins to Jefferson’s Reserve. Hollins plays for New England, which is on bye this week.
Week 10 is final. LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix and Hold My DK are 9-1, Dude, Your Getting a Dell is 0-10, and four teams are tied at 5-5 or 6-4 for the last three playoff spots.

stories.title: Week 10: Hold My DK beats me by 117.42, Asian Jim steals Monday night, and Dude, Your Getting a Dell is 0‑10
stories.dek: Two teams are 9‑1, four teams are fighting over three playoff spots, and I'm 3‑7 with no quarterback for Week 11.
body: Hold My DK 196.34, StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte 78.92. That's a 117.42-point margin, the biggest of the week and the second-biggest of the season behind Catfan94's 127.22 in Week 5. Christian McCaffrey had 50.3, Patrick Mahomes 45.92, and Derrick Henry added 16.5 on Monday night with two touchdowns on 10 yards rushing. Chuba Hubbard scored 35.7 on the bench. TheMoneyTeam2302 is 9‑1 and has scored 1582.92 points.

The game of the week happened Monday. Kraft for Cash led Asian Jim 89.30 to 84.06 going into Chargers at Ravens, and BTaylor1 had Zay Flowers left against three for ManicOrientals. Flowers scored 9.9. Omarion Hampton ran for 105 yards and a touchdown for 19.0, Tre' Harris caught five for 86 (12.6) and Justice Hill added 7.8. Final: Asian Jim 123.46, Kraft for Cash 99.20. ManicOrientals pulled Ladd McConkey for Harris before kickoff, and that move is worth a win. Asian Jim has won three straight and is 5‑5.

LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix beat Jefferson’s Reserve 232.54 to 134.62, the second-highest score in league history, and is 9‑1 with six straight wins. The Champ beat Dude, Your Getting a Dell 166.08 to 68.10; Jacoby Brissett threw for 340 yards and scored 12.3, and Br0phy is 0‑10. Catfan94’s Farm Team beat OBJAY 138.94 to 83.62, and I Chase Brown Kids beat Bourbon Lover 124.46 to 116.92 in the closest game of the week.

Bad beat: Jefferson’s Reserve scored 134.62, the fifth-highest score of the week, and lost by 97.92. Low score: Dude, Your Getting a Dell at 68.10. And for the record, I scored 78.92 and started AJ Barner at superflex while Dalton Schultz (8.1) and Samaje Perine (13.9) sat on my bench. Swap those two in and I score 93.12 and lose by 103.22 instead of 117.42. Still the worst week of anyone not named Br0phy.

stories.title: Six teams on bye, and LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix loses both backup quarterbacks in the same week
stories.dek: Atlanta, Cleveland, Green Bay, the Rams, New England and Seattle are off. Some of you are about to start a tight end at superflex. Some of you are me.
body: This is the worst bye week of the year, and it hits the top of the standings first. Michael Penix Jr. (Atlanta) and Jordan Love (Green Bay) are both off, so LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix has Josh Allen and nobody else at quarterback. Malik Willis is on IR and Brock Bowers is Out with the ankle. Catfan94 is still a 36.2-point favorite over I Chase Brown Kids, which tells you how much is left on that roster.

Catfan94’s Farm Team loses Deshaun Watson, Jadarian Price, Christian Watson and KC Concepcion Jr. to byes, and Baker Mayfield is Questionable. jrsmith1391 does get Kenneth Walker III back if Ian Rapoport is right. Asian Jim loses Jaxon Smith-Njigba, the 31.6-point guy from Week 10, to Seattle's bye, and Kyler Murray is still Out.

The Champ loses Matthew Stafford, Matthew Golden and Harold Fannin Jr., and still has Joe Burrow and Jared Goff. Kraft for Cash loses Quinshon Judkins, Kyren Williams and Tucker Kraft. I Chase Brown Kids loses Bijan Robinson and Blake Corum, but ZachCarroll09 has six quarterbacks, so the superflex spot is the one thing he'll never worry about.

Then there's me. Drake Maye is hurt and New England is on bye anyway. Jalen Hurts is on IR. Shedeur Sanders is on my taxi squad and Cleveland is on bye. That leaves Justin Fields, the Kansas City backup, and Sleeper doesn't project him for a single point. Zach Charbonnet, AJ Barner, Kaleb Johnson, Konata Mumpfield and Denzel Boston are on bye too. I'm a 48.5-point underdog to The Champ, and honestly that number is generous.

stories.title: Four weeks left: Kraft for Cash is 6‑4, and The Champ, Jefferson’s Reserve and Asian Jim are all 5‑5
stories.dek: Six teams make it. The top three are close to locked. The tiebreaker is points for, and TJohn91 has the most of the 5‑5 teams by a lot.
body: LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix and Hold My DK are 9‑1. Catfan94’s Farm Team is 7‑3. Those three are at least two games clear of seventh place with four weeks to play, so the real fight is for spots four through six between Kraft for Cash at 6‑4 and three teams at 5‑5.

Points for is the tiebreaker. Among the 5‑5 teams: The Champ 1414.72, Jefferson’s Reserve 1253.50, Asian Jim 1191.98. TJohn91 is 161.22 points ahead of jmello16 and 222.74 ahead of ManicOrientals, which is almost two full weeks of scoring. If it's a three-way tie at the end, the two-time champ is in.

I Chase Brown Kids (1219.86) and OBJAY (1184.34) are 4‑6, one game back. Bourbon Lover and StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte are 3‑7 and need four straight wins and some help. Dude, Your Getting a Dell is 0‑10 and mathematically eliminated: seven teams already have five wins, and Br0phy can finish with four at best.

This week's games that matter: Jefferson’s Reserve is a 22.3-point favorite over Bourbon Lover. Kraft for Cash is a 19.0-point favorite over OBJAY. Catfan94’s Farm Team is a 27.7-point favorite over Asian Jim, with Smith-Njigba on bye. And The Champ gets me, a team with no quarterback, so pencil TJohn91 in for 6‑5.

stories.title: Kraft for Cash had a 5.24-point lead and one player left. It lost by 24.26.
stories.dek: Zay Flowers scored 9.9 and three Chargers and Ravens scored 39.4. Starting Justin Herbert wouldn't have saved it.
body: Kraft for Cash went into Monday up 89.30 to 84.06 as an 18.5-point pregame favorite. Flowers caught six for 74 and scored 9.9. ManicOrientals got 19.0 from Omarion Hampton, 12.6 from Tre' Harris and 7.8 from Justice Hill, a 39.4-point night from three players. The final was 123.46 to 99.20.

Justin Herbert ran for a touchdown and scored 16.26 on the Kraft for Cash bench while Bryce Young scored 8.1 in the lineup. That swap is worth 8.16 points, and Kraft for Cash still loses by 16.10. Herbert had been expected to play after negative imaging on his non-throwing hand, so starting Young wasn't crazy. The problem was Kyren Williams (4.7), Travis Kelce (5.5) and Tetairoa McMillan (6.0) in the lineup.

BTaylor1 is 6‑4, a game ahead of three 5‑5 teams, and has OBJAY next. OBJAY has Geno Smith Out and Jaxson Dart on IR, so JAY2913 is down to Bo Nix and Kyle McCord at quarterback. Kraft for Cash loses Quinshon Judkins, Kyren Williams and Tucker Kraft to byes and is still a 19.0-point favorite.

columns.title: MONDAY NIGHT!! THREE CHARGERS AND RAVENS!! ASIAN JIM!!
columns.dek: Hugh G. Rection stayed up for Chargers 23, Ravens 20 and has not calmed down since.
body: DOWN 5.24! ONE GUY LEFT FOR Kraft for Cash! THREE GUYS LEFT FOR Asian Jim! AND THEN OMARION HAMPTON RUNS FOR 105 YARDS AND A TOUCHDOWN! NINETEEN POINTS! TRE' HARRIS FIVE CATCHES, 86 YARDS! JUSTICE HILL 7.8! THIRTY-NINE POINT FOUR FROM THREE GUYS ON A MONDAY! I KNOCKED THE DUNKIN' OFF THE SHRINE AGAIN!

ZAY FLOWERS? 9.9! BTaylor1 HAD AN 18.5-POINT LINE AND LOST BY 24.26! THAT'S A 42.76-POINT SWING AGAINST THE SPREAD! I DID THAT MATH ON A NAPKIN AND THEN I CHECKED IT TWICE BECAUSE I DIDN'T BELIEVE IT!

AND Hold My DK HUNG 196.34 ON THE GUY WHO RUNS THIS WEBSITE! 117.42-POINT WIN! HE STARTED A TIGHT END AT SUPERFLEX! IN MY HOUSE THAT'S A FELONY! FOUR WEEKS LEFT! FOUR TEAMS FOR THREE SPOTS! I'M NOT SLEEPING UNTIL WEEK 14!

columns.title: Kraft for Cash didn't lose on Monday. It lost on Sunday, and Monday just made it official.
columns.dek: Richard "Dick" Gozinya watched the film. Benching Justin Herbert isn't what cost BTaylor1 this one.
body: Everybody wants to talk about Herbert's 16.26 on the bench. Fine. Swap him in for Bryce Young and Kraft for Cash scores 107.36. Asian Jim scored 123.46. You still lose by 16.10. The quarterback call is not the story.

The story is Kyren Williams 4.7, Travis Kelce 5.5 and Tetairoa McMillan 6.0 in the lineup. That's three starters combining for 16.2. When I played, if three guys took a Sunday off, the coach didn't blame the backup quarterback. He ran all three until somebody threw up.

BTaylor1 is 6‑4 and still in fourth place. OBJAY is next, with Bo Nix and Kyle McCord at quarterback. Win that and nobody remembers Monday. Lose that and you're one of four teams fighting for three chairs, and you're the one standing when the music stops. Toughen up.

columns.title: 6 bye-week tips from Holden McGroin, who once started a punter on bye and called it 'resting him'
columns.dek: Six NFL teams are off this week. Holden McGroin has a plan for all of them, and every plan is wrong.
body: 1. Start your bye-week players anyway. They're rested. Fresh legs score more points, and zero is technically a number, which means it's technically a score.

2. LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix has Michael Penix Jr. and Jordan Love on bye. Catfan94 should bench Josh Allen too, for team chemistry. Nobody likes the one guy who shows up when everybody else stayed home.

3. Bill_Buttlicker's only available quarterback is Justin Fields, Kansas City's backup. My advice: start Fields at quarterback and Shedeur Sanders at superflex. I'm told Shedeur is on the taxi squad and Cleveland is on bye. That's two reasons he'll be well-rested.
4. Hold My DK is a 77.0-point favorite. Br0phy should try to make it close by trading away everyone who scored last week. Fewer players means fewer bad decisions. That's addition.
5. Kenneth Walker III is expected back for Kansas City, so drop Emmett Johnson immediately. He only scored 34.6 last week. Players who score 34.6 are due to score less, and I'd rather get out early.
6. When in doubt, start the guy with the coolest name. That's how I finished 14th in a 12-team league, and nobody's ever been able to explain it.

columns.title: Hold My DK scored 2.88 units of Dude, Your Getting a Dell. My new unit is getting a workout.
columns.dek: Ivana Humpalot has run the Week 10 numbers through the spreadsheet and the spreadsheet has opinions.
body: Yesterday I invented a unit of fantasy scoring: one Dude, Your Getting a Dell, equal to whatever that team scored that week. Then Jacoby Brissett scored 12.3 on Monday night and the final Week 10 unit came in at 68.10, so I re-ran everything. Hold My DK scored 196.34, which is 2.88 units. LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix scored 232.54, or 3.41 units.

Season-long, LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix has 1714.68 points and Dude, Your Getting a Dell has 784.82. That's 2.18 units of Dude, Your Getting a Dell per Catfan94, a ratio I'm calling the Catfan Coefficient. Catfan94's lead over Br0phy is 929.86 points, which is more than Br0phy has scored all year. My model says that's bad for Br0phy. My model is right.

Br0phy's all-play record is 5-105, a 4.5% win rate. Bill_Buttlicker's is 28-82, or 25.5%. That makes Bill_Buttlicker 5.6 times more competitive than Br0phy, which my spreadsheet labels 'Almost Mediocre.' Bill_Buttlicker asked me to change the label. I did not.
